notes.title: Flight Catastrophe - Manage the crew
notes.content:
Welcome, aviation and disaster enthusiasts, to the riveting world of airline ownership and airport management!

Assuming control of an entire airline, along with its associated airport, presents a formidable challenge. Indeed, it's a task of monumental proportions that cannot be shouldered alone. You can't simultaneously play the roles of CEO, pilot, and flight attendant!

Building a Team

To navigate this colossal responsibility, assembling a capable team is paramount. You need a dedicated staff to ensure the smooth operation of flights, generating revenue while you oversee the broader strategy. Picture yourself seated at the helm of your command center, your office, meticulously scrutinizing resumes. Each document before you provides a glimpse into the potential of the individuals therein, detailing their qualifications and capabilities. These statistics serve as your guide, revealing the cost of hiring each employee and their prowess in managing crisis situations mid-flight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38415958/4181499d4bf126dae0c190621889148f6699d822.png

Get ready to embark on a journey where every decision matters, every team member plays a vital role, and the stakes are sky-high!

Fly high !
~Trigger Labs Team


Remember that what you see shows work in progress and is not the final product.

notes.title: Flight Catastrophe : In the skies & on land
notes.content:
Exciting progress in the development of the Flight Catastrophe game!


We're excited to share some fantastic updates on the development of Flight Catastrophe, our upcoming game where players take on the challenging role of preventing airline disasters. The journey has been exciting, and we're excited to showcase the latest developments.

One of the most significant advances we've made is expanding the game beyond the skies. Yes, you heard right! Flight Catastrophe now includes not only exciting challenges in the air, but also allows players to manage airports and fleets of aircraft on the ground. This expansion opens up a whole new dimension of gameplay, offering players a more immersive and diverse experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38415958/f9fb4cd58264cf6de9c87dfa1701399d59622762.png

Imagine not only preventing disasters in the skies, but also strategically organizing smooth operations on the ground. From building buildings and buying new planes, to managing your aircrew.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38415958/42f1fbd2738691e9eab36167c2ccf4086781ed8b.gif

What's more, ground duties will also require good financial and time management. Yes, the player's decisions in relation to aircraft flights also occur here! How many flights in a row can you fly? More flights mean more money, but also a greater chance for something to go wrong during the flight.... 
Stay tuned for more updates, and let's make aviation history together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38415958/31615d86fd9b40fa2ef743b53dac0d2100076b0b.png

Fly high!
Trigger Labs Team

notes.title: Let's Talk About: Flight Catastrophe
notes.content:
Dear Community,

We are happy to share some fantastic news with you! After a period of waiting and uncertainty, we want to assure you that Flight Catastrophe has not been abandoned and work on the game is back on trajectory.

We are working up and will share with you the progress as fast as the SR-72 is ;)

Earlier we encountered challenges and had to put the project on hold. Many of you have been patiently waiting for updates, and we appreciate your commitment to our game.

Now, with the successful release of Pandemic Train, we have gained the necessary resources and support to resume work on Flight Catastrophe. We have heard your questions and enthusiasm for the game and are committed to delivering an unforgettable experience.

Stay tuned for more updates as we progress through our development process. Your continued support is very important to us, and we can't wait to share the flight space with you in Flight Catastrophe!

Now, you have the opportunity to take a look behind the scenes of the production, so we quietly fly away, and keep working!

Soar High,
Trigger Labs
